Container.Name: paperless-ngx-dedupe
Container.Overview:
Duplicate finder for Paperless-ngx. Syncs your documents via the Paperless API, finds exact and near-duplicates (MinHash/LSH with Jaccard + fuzzy scoring and a discriminative penalty against template look-alikes such as monthly invoices) and lets you review each group side by side before anything is removed. Deleted documents go to the Paperless trash.
SECURITY: the app has NO built-in authentication. Anyone who can reach the port can review and delete documents with the permissions of the configured Paperless user. Do not expose it to the internet - put it behind a reverse proxy with access control or keep it LAN-only.
Before Installing: 1. Create an API token in Paperless-ngx (user menu - My Profile - API Auth Token). The user needs delete permissions on the documents you want to clean up. 2. Set Paperless URL to the address the container can reach, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000 (no trailing path). 3. If you access the UI through a reverse proxy (HTTPS domain), set Origin to that exact URL (e.g. https://dedupe.example.com), otherwise saving and actions fail with a CSRF / cross-site POST error. Leave it empty for direct access via http://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:3000. 4. After the first start open the Web UI, run a sync and then the analysis. Thresholds can be tuned under Settings.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: paperless paperless-ngx duplicate duplicates dedupe deduplication documents dms minhash
Container.Requires: A running Paperless-ngx instance and an API token (or username/password) of a Paperless user.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: SQLite database of the app (sync cache, duplicate groups, settings)

Config.Name: Paperless URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Paperless-ngx instance as seen from the container, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000

Config.Name: Paperless API Token
Config.Description: API token of a Paperless user (Paperless: My Profile - API Auth Token). Preferred over username/password. The user needs delete permissions on the documents you want to clean up.

Config.Name: Origin
Config.Description: Public URL when accessed through a reverse proxy, e.g. https://dedupe.example.com (SvelteKit CSRF check). Leave empty for direct access via IP:port.

Config.Name: Paperless Username
Config.Description: Alternative to the API token: Paperless username (requires Paperless Password). Ignored when an API token is set.

Config.Name: Paperless Password
Config.Description: Alternative to the API token: Paperless password (requires Paperless Username).

Config.Name: AI Enabled
Config.Description: Optional AI-based document classification / metadata extraction via OpenAI. Requires an OpenAI API key. Documents are sent to OpenAI when enabled.

Config.Name: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: Required only when AI Enabled is true.

Config.Name: CORS Allow Origin
Config.Description: Empty = same-origin only (recommended), * = all origins, or a specific origin URL

Config.Name: Prometheus Metrics
Config.Description: Expose app metrics in Prometheus format at /api/v1/metrics

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid default: 99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid default: 100 = users)
